title: warden airdrop
description: gather tools and resources before the warden get dropped.
body:
get tools and resources before the timer runs out and warden get dropped!

can you do that in 10 minutes? (probably not!)

 

 

## **how to play**
1. turn on the cheats. (otherwise the datapack won't work)

2. when you're ready, type **/function wc:start** in the chat.

 

 

## **explaination**
after you enter the command the world border will shrink to 150 and your timer will start.

after 10 minutes world border will shrink to 75 and you will be teleported in the center of the map where the warden is spawned.
